name: 62207 · E Saint Louis, IL
findings: ZIP 62207 (E Saint Louis) has 30 nonprofit organizations. 5 of them (17%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 4 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (80% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 62207 (E Saint Louis) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
